source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 25ης Νοεμβρίου — «Άγιος Πορφύριος ο Στρατηλάτης»

attestations.note: The life page `https://www.saint.gr/1057/saint.aspx` heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 25 Νοεμβρίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. None of the corpus's Porphyrius folders is this man — `porphyrius-the-mime-15-september`, `porphyrios-of-kapsokalyvia` and the `porphyrius-the-mime-4-november` of this same wave are all other days and other men — and the epithet in the display name is the page's own «ο Στρατηλάτης», the commander, which is not a type the corpus holds, so `soldier` carries it. **The two hundred soldiers the page says died with him are not given a folder**, because it does not name one of them and does not enumerate them as a company with a line of their own; they stand in the life. No year, no place, no hymn. No asterisk and not the sentence «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη η ύπαρξη του Αγίου».
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue as printed by pravoslavno.rs for the corresponding Julian day (2 October 2026).
